nodes.text:
🦠 HMPV in India Update:

1️⃣ Two infants in Bengaluru are the first to test positive for Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV).

2️⃣ The virus is not new and is already circulating globally.

3️⃣ Both infants had a history of bronchopneumonia and are recovering.

4️⃣ No travel history, https://t.co/co6p0ITyEK
